'''900''' ('''nine hundred''') is the [[natural number]] following [[899 (number)|899]] and preceding [[901 (number)|901]]. 

== In mathematics ==
It is the [[square number|square]] of [[30 (number)|30]] and the sum of [[Euler's totient function]] for the first 54 [[positive integer]]s. In base 10, it is a [[Harshad number]]. It is also the first number to be the square of a [[sphenic number]].

==In other fields==
'''900''' is also:

* In Greek [[Greek numerals|number symbols]], the sign [[Sampi]] ("ϡ", literally "like a [[Pi (letter)|pi]]")
* A [[900 (skateboarding trick)|skateboarding trick]] in which the skateboarder spins two and a half times (360 degrees times 2.5 is 900)
* A [[900 series (bowling)|900 series]] refers to three consecutive [[Perfect game (bowling)|perfect games]] in [[bowling]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-01-13|title=Bowler throws 36 consecutive strikes for incredible 900 series|url=https://ftw.usatoday.com/2016/01/bowler-throws-36-consecutive-strikes-for-incredible-900-series|access-date=2021-03-31|website=For The Win|language=en-US}}</ref>
* [[Yoda]]'s age in [[Star Wars]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sawan |first=Amer |date=2024-06-14 |title=How Old is Yoda in The Phantom Menace? |url=https://www.cbr.com/star-wars-yoda-age/ |access-date=2025-04-19 |website=CBR |language=en}}</ref>

==[[Integers]] from 901 to 999==

===900s===

==== 901 ====
901 = 17 × 53. It is a [[centered triangular number]] and a [[happy number]].

==== 902 ====
902 = 2 × 11 × 41. It is a  [[sphenic number]], a [[nontotient]], and a Harshad number.

==== 903 ====
903 = 3 × 7 × 43. It is a sphenic number, a [[oeis:A001003|little Schroeder number]], a [[Schröder–Hipparchus number]], a zero of [[Mertens function]], and the 42nd [[triangular number]].<ref name="tn">{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000217|title=Sloane's A000217: Triangular numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 904 ====
904 = 2<sup>3</sup> × 113. It is a [[refactorable number]], a [[Lazy caterer's sequence|lazy caterer number]], and a zero of Mertens function. There are 904 1's in all partitions of 26 into odd parts.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A036469|Partial sums of A000009 (partitions into distinct parts)}}</ref>

==== 905 ====
905 = 5 × 181. It is the smallest composite de Polignac number<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A098237|title=Sloane's A098237: Composite de Polignac numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2022-05-10}}</ref> and the sum of seven consecutive primes (109 + 113 + 127 + 131 + 137 + 139 + 149).

"The 905" is [[Area codes 905, 289 and 365#905 in popular culture|a common nickname]] for the suburban portions of the [[Greater Toronto Area]] in Canada, a region whose telephones used [[Area codes 905, 289 and 365|area code 905]] before [[overlay plan]]s added two more area codes.

==== 906 ====
906 = 2 × 3 × 151. It is a [[strobogrammatic]] number, a sphenic number, and a zero of Mertens function.

==== 907 ====
907 is a prime number.

==== 908 ====
908 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 227. It is a nontotient. There are 908 primitive sorting networks on 6 elements.<ref name="A006245">{{cite OEIS|A006245|Number of primitive sorting networks on n elements; also number of rhombic tilings of a 2n-gon|access-date=2022-05-24}}</ref> There are 908 rhombic tilings of a 12-gon.<ref name="A006245" />

==== 909 ====
909 = 3<sup>2</sup> × 101. There are 909 non-isomorphic aperiodic multiset partitions of weight 7.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A303546|Number of non-isomorphic aperiodic multiset partitions of weight n|access-date=2022-05-24}}</ref>

===910s===

==== 910 ====
910 = 2 × 5 × 7 × 13. It is a Harshad number, a [[happy number]], a zreo of Mertens function, and a balanced number.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A020492|Balanced numbers: numbers k such that phi(k) (A000010) divides sigma(k) (A000203)}}</ref> There are 910 polynomial symmetric functions of matrix of order 7 under separate row and column permutations.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A007716|Number of polynomial symmetric functions of matrix of order n under separate row and column permutations}}</ref>

==== 911 ====
{{Redirect|911 (number)|the emergency phone number|911 (emergency telephone number)}}

It is a [[prime number]], a [[Sophie Germain prime]],<ref name="pn">{{Cite web |last=Vanovschi |first=Vitalii |title=Properties of the number 911 |url=http://www.numberempire.com:80/911 |access-date=2026-08-23 |website=www.numberempire.com |language=en}}</ref> and the sum of three consecutive primes (293 + 307 + 311). It is an [[Eisenstein prime]] with no imaginary part<ref>{{cite OEIS|A068231|Primes congruent to 11 mod 12}}</ref> and real part of the form <math>3n-1</math>. Since 913 is a [[semiprime]], 911 is a [[Chen prime]].<ref>{{cite OEIS|A109611|Chen primes}}</ref>

It is also a [[centered decagonal number]].<ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A062786|2=Centered 10-gonal numbers|access-date=2016-06-02}}</ref><ref name="pn"/>

There are 911 [[inverse semigroup]]s of order 7.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A001428|Number of inverse semigroups of order n, considered to be equivalent when they are isomorphic or anti-isomorphic (by reversal of the operator)}}</ref>

911 is obtained by [[Concatenation|concatenating]] its product of digits and sum of digits.

911 can be a short form of referring to [[9/11|the terrorist attack]] in the United States in 2001.

==== 912 ====
912 = 2<sup>4</sup> × 3 × 19. It is a Harshad number, the sum of four consecutive primes (223 + 227 + 229 + 233), and the sum of ten consecutive primes (71 + 73 + 79 + 83 + 89 + 97 + 101 + 103 + 107 + 109).

==== 913 ====
913 = 11 × 83. It is a [[Smith number]]<ref name="is">{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006753|title=Sloane's A006753 : Smith numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a zero of Mertens function.

==== 914 ====
914 = 2 × 457. It is a nontotient. There are 914 compositions of 11 that are neither weakly increasing nor weakly decreasing.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A332834|Number of compositions of n that are neither weakly increasing nor weakly decreasing|access-date=2022-05-23}}</ref>

==== 915 ====
915 = 3 × 5 × 61. It is a sphenic number, a Smith number,<ref name="is"/> a Harshad number, and a zero of Mertens function.

==== 916 ====
916 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 229. It is a [[strobogrammatic]] number, a zero of Mertens function, a nontotient, and a member of the [[Mian–Chowla sequence]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A005282|title=Sloane's A005282 : Mian-Chowla sequence|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 917 ====
917 = 7 × 131. It is the sum of five consecutive primes (173 + 179 + 181 + 191 + 193).

==== 918 ====
918 = 2 × 3<sup>3</sup> × 17. It is a Harshad number.

==== 919 ====
919 is a prime number, a [[cuban prime]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002407|title=Sloane's A002407 : Cuban primes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a [[oeis:A006450|prime index prime]], a [[Chen prime]], a [[palindromic prime]], a[[centered hexagonal number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A003215|title=Sloane's A003215 : Hex (or centered hexagonal) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a zero of Mertens function.

===920s===

==== 920 ====
920 = 2<sup>3</sup> × 5 × 23. It is a zero of  Mertens function. There are a total of 920 nodes in all rooted trees with 8 nodes.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A055544|Total number of nodes in all rooted trees with n nodes|access-date=2022-05-23}} </ref>

==== 921 ====
921 = 3 × 307. There are 921 enriched r-trees of size 7.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A301462|Number of enriched r-trees of size n|access-date=2022-05-23}}</ref>

==== 922 ====
922 = 2 × 461. It is a nontotient and a Smith number.<ref name="is"/>

==== 923 ====
923 = 13 × 71. There are 923 combinations of 6 things from 1 to 6 at a time.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A030662|Number of combinations of n things from 1 to n at a time, with repeats allowed|access-date=2022-05-23}}</ref>

==== 924 ====
924 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 3 × 7 × 11. It is the sum of a twin prime (461 + 463), [[central binomial coefficient]] <math>\tbinom {12} 6</math>.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000984|title=Sloane's A000984 : Central binomial coefficients|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 925 ====
925 = 5<sup>2</sup> × 37. It is a [[pentagonal number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000326|title=Sloane's A000326 : Pentagonal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a [[centered square number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A001844|title=Sloane's A001844 : Centered square numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

925 is the [[millesimal fineness]] number for [[Sterling silver]].

==== 926 ====
926 = 2 × 463. It is a nontotient and the sum of six consecutive primes (139 + 149 + 151 + 157 + 163 + 167).

==== 927 ====
927 = 3<sup>2</sup> × 103. It is a [[tribonacci number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000073|title=Sloane's A000073 : Tribonacci numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 928 ====
928 = 2<sup>5</sup> × 29. It is a [[happy number]], the sum of four consecutive primes (227 + 229 + 233 + 239), and the sum of eight consecutive primes (101 + 103 + 107 + 109 + 113 + 127 + 131 + 137).

==== 929 ====
929 is a prime number, a [[Proth prime]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A080076|title=Sloane's A080076 : Proth primes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a palindromic prime, an [[Eisenstein prime]] with no imaginary part, and the sum of nine consecutive primes (83 + 89 + 97 + 101 + 103 + 107 + 109 + 113 + 127).

There are 929 chapters in [[Tanakh]], giving the name to [[929: Tanakh B'yachad]].<ref>{{Cite news|url = https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Crack-open-your-Bible-929-day-study-project-begins-in-Jerusalem-385067|title = Crack open your Bible: 929 day study project begins in Jerusalem|date = December 18, 2014|access-date = January 1, 2015|work=[[The Jerusalem Post]]}}</ref>

The [[PDF417]] barcode format uses a [[finite field|GF(929)]] error-correction code.<ref name="iso2006">{{Citation | author= ISO/IEC | title= Information technology &ndash; Automatic identification and data capture techniques &ndash; PDF417 bar code symbology specification | year= 2006 | edition= second | id= ISO/IEC 15438:2006(E) | url= http://webstore.iec.ch/preview/info_isoiec15438%7Bed2.0%7Den.pdf | access-date= 2011-09-16 | archive-date= 2011-04-09 | archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20110409140736/http://webstore.iec.ch/preview/info_isoiec15438%7Bed2.0%7Den.pdf | url-status= dead }}</ref>

===930s===

==== 930 ====
930 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 31. It is a [[pronic number]].<ref name="ob">{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002378|title=Sloane's A002378 : Oblong (or promic, pronic, or heteromecic) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 931 ====
931 = 7<sup>2</sup> × 19. It is the sum of three consecutive primes (307 + 311 + 313). It is a repdigit in two different bases 111<sub>30</sub> and 777<sub>11</sub>. There are 931 regular simple graphs spanning 7 vertices.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A319612|Number of regular simple graphs spanning n vertices|access-date=2022-05-23}}</ref>

==== 932 ====
932 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 233. There are 932 regular simple graphs on 7 labeled nodes.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A295193|Number of regular simple graphs on n labeled nodes|access-date=2022-05-22}}</ref>

==== 933 ====
933 = 3 × 311.

==== 934 ====
934 = 2 × 467. It is a nontotient.

==== 935 ====
935 = 5 × 11 × 17. It is a sphenic number, a [[Lucas–Carmichael number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006972|title=Sloane's A006972 : Lucas-Carmichael numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a Harshad number.

==== 936 ====
936 = 2<sup>3</sup> × 3<sup>2</sup> × 13. It is a [[pentagonal pyramidal number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002411|title=Sloane's A002411 : Pentagonal pyramidal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a Harshad number.

==== 937 ====
937 is a prime number, a Chen prime, a [[star number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A003154|title=Sloane's A003154 : Centered 12-gonal numbers. Also star numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a [[happy number]].

==== 938 ====
938 = 2 × 7 × 67. It is a sphenic number and a nontotient. There are 938 lines through at least 2 points of an 8 × 8 grid of points.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A018808|Number of lines through at least 2 points of an n X n grid of points|access-date=2022-05-22}}</ref>

==== 939 ====
939 = 3 × 313. There are 939 V-toothpicks after 31 rounds of the honeycomb sequence.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A161206|V-toothpick (or honeycomb) sequence}}</ref>

===940s===

==== 940 ====
940 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 5 × 47. It is the totient sum for the first 55 integers.

==== 941 ====
941 is a prime number, a Chen prime, and an Eisenstein prime with no imaginary part. It is the sum of three consecutive primes (311 + 313 + 317) and the sum of five consecutive primes (179 + 181 + 191 + 193 + 197).

==== 942 ====
942 = 2 × 3 × 157. It is a sphenic number, a convolved Fibonacci number,<ref>{{cite OEIS|A001628|Convolved Fibonacci numbers}}</ref> a nontotient, and the sum of four consecutive primes (229 + 233 + 239 + 241).

==== 943 ====
943 = 23 × 41.

==== 944 ====
944 = 2<sup>4</sup> × 59. It is a nontotient and a Lehmer-Comtet number.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A005727|2=n-th derivative of x^x at x=1. Also called Lehmer-Comtet numbers}}</ref>

==== 945 ====
945 = 3<sup>3</sup> × 5 × 7. It is a [[Leyland number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A076980|title=Sloane's A076980 : Leyland numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> the smallest odd [[abundant number]],<ref>{{cite book |title=Number Story: From Counting to Cryptography |url=https://archive.org/details/numberstoryfromc00higg_612 |url-access=limited |last=Higgins |first=Peter |year=2008 |publisher=Copernicus |location=New York |isbn=978-1-84800-000-1 |page=[https://archive.org/details/numberstoryfromc00higg_612/page/n22 13] }}</ref> the smallest odd [[primitive abundant number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006038|title=Sloane's A006038 : Odd primitive abundant numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and the smallest odd [[primitive semiperfect number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006036|title=Sloane's A006036 : Primitive pseudoperfect numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> 945 is the [[double factorial]] of [[9 (number)|9]]: 945 = 9!!.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006882|title=Sloane's A006882 : Double factorials|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 946 ====
946 = 2 × 11 × 43. It is a sphenic number, a [[hexagonal number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000384|title=Sloane's A000384 : Hexagonal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a [[happy number]], and the 43rd [[triangular number]].<ref name="tn"/> 

==== 947 ====
947 is a prime number, a [[balanced prime]],<ref name="bp">{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A006562|title=Sloane's A006562 : Balanced primes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a [[Chen prime]], a [[Lazy caterer's sequence|lazy caterer number]], an [[Eisenstein prime]] with no imaginary part, and the sum of seven consecutive primes (113 + 127 + 131 + 137 + 139 + 149 + 151). 

==== 948 ====
948 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 3 × 79. It is a nontotient. It forms a [[Ruth–Aaron pair]] with 949 under the second definition. There are 948 combinatory separations of normal multisets of weight 6.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A269134|Number of combinatory separations of normal multisets of weight n|access-date=2022-05-13}}</ref>

==== 949 ====
949 = 13 × 73. It forms a Ruth–Aaron pair with 948 under the second definition.

===950s===

==== 950 ====
950 = 2 × 5<sup>2</sup> × 19. It is a nontotient and a [[generalized pentagonal number]].<ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A001318|2=Generalized pentagonal numbers|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 951 ====
951 = 3 × 317. It is a [[centered pentagonal number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A005891|title=Sloane's A005891 : Centered pentagonal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 952 ====
{{Redirect|952 (number)|the card game|9-5-2}}
952 = 2<sup>3</sup> × 7 × 17. There are 952 reduced words of length 3 in the Weyl group D_17.<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A162328|Number of reduced words of length n in the Weyl group D_17|access-date=2022-05-12}}</ref> There are 952 regions in regular tetradecagon with all diagonals drawn.<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A007678|Number of regions in regular n-gon with all diagonals drawn. |access-date=2022-05-13}}</ref>

==== 953 ====
953 is a prime number, a Sophie Germain prime,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A005384|title=Sloane's A005384 : Sophie Germain primes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a Chen prime, an Eisenstein prime with no imaginary part, and a [[centered heptagonal number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A069099|title=Sloane's A069099 : Centered heptagonal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 954 ====
954 = 2 × 3<sup>2</sup> × 53. It is a nontotient, a Harshad number, and the sum of ten consecutive primes (73 + 79 + 83 + 89 + 97 + 101 + 103 + 107 + 109 + 113). It is sixth derivative of x^(x^x) evaluated at x=1.<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A179230|2=n-th derivative of x^(x^x) at x=1}}</ref> 

==== 955 ====
955 = 5 × 191. There are 955 transitive rooted trees with 17 nodes.

==== 956 ====
956 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 239. There are 956 compositions of 13 into powers of 2.<ref>{{OEIS|A023359|Number of compositions of n into powers of 2|access-date=2022-05-11}}</ref>

==== 957 ====
957 = 3 × 11 × 29 = antisigma(45).<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A024816|Antisigma(n): Sum of the numbers less than n that do not divide n|access-date=2016-05-11}}</ref> It is a sphenic number.

==== 958 ====
958 = 2 × 479. It is a nontotient and a [[Smith number]].<ref name="is"/> 

It is the [[millesimal fineness]] number for [[Britannia silver]]

==== 959 ====
959 = 7 × 137. It is a composite de Polignac number.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A098237|title=Sloane's A098237: Composite de Polignac numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2022-05-10}}</ref>

===960s===

==== 960 ====
960 = 2<sup>6</sup> × 3 × 5. It is aHarshad number and the sum of six consecutive primes (149 + 151 + 157 + 163 + 167 + 173).

There are 960 possible starting positions for the chess variant [[Chess960]].

==== 961 ====
961 = 31<sup>2</sup>. It is the largest 3-digit perfect square and a [[centered octagonal number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A016754|title=Sloane's A016754 : Odd squares: a(n) = (2n+1)^2. Also centered octagonal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> It is the sum of three consecutive primes (313 + 317 + 331) and the sum of five consecutive primes (181 + 191 + 193 + 197 + 199).

==== 962 ====
962 = 2 × 13 × 37. It is a sphenic number and a nontotient.

==== 963 ====
963 = 3<sup>2</sup> × 107. It is the sum of the first 24 primes.

==== 964 ====
964 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 241. It is a [[happy number]], a nontotient, the totient sum of the first 56 integers, and the sum of four consecutive primes (233 + 239 + 241 + 251).

==== 965 ====
965 = 5 × 193.

==== 966 ====
966 = 2 × 3 × 7 × 23 = [[stirling numbers of the second kind|<math>\left\{ {8 \atop 3} \right\}</math>]]. It is a Harshad number and the sum of eight consecutive primes (103 + 107 + 109 + 113 + 127 + 131 + 137 + 139).

==== 967 ====
967 is a prime number and a [[oeis:A006450|prime index prime]].

==== 968 ====
968 = 2<sup>3</sup> × 11<sup>2</sup>. It is a nontotient and an [[Achilles number]].

==== 969 ====
969 = 3 × 17 × 19. It is a sphenic number, a [[nonagonal number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A001106|title=Sloane's A001106 : 9-gonal (or enneagonal or nonagonal) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a [[tetrahedral number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000292|title=Sloane's A000292 : Tetrahedral numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>
* age of [[Methuselah]] according to Old Testament, [[969 Movement|anti-Muslim movement in Myanmar]]

===970s===

==== 970 ====
970 = 2 × 5 × 97. It is a sphenic number and a [[heptagonal number]].

==== 971 ====
971 is a [[prime number]], an [[emirp]], a [[Chen prime]], and an [[Eisenstein prime]] with no imaginary part.

==== 972 ====
972 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 3<sup>5</sup>. It is a Harshad number<ref>{{cite OEIS|A005349|Niven (or Harshad, or harshad) numbers: numbers that are divisible by the sum of their digits}}</ref> and an Achilles number.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A052486|2=Achilles numbers - powerful but imperfect: if n = Product(p_i^e_i) then all e_i > 1 (i.e., powerful), but the highest common factor of the e_i is 1, i.e., not a perfect power.}}</ref>
* 972 has Anti-Factors = 5, 8, 24, 29, 67, 72, 216, 389, 648
* The Sum of Anti-Factors of 972 = number * (n/2) where n is an Odd number. So, it is a Hemi-Anti-Perfect Number. Other such Numbers include 2692, etc.
Sum of Anti-Factors = 5 + 8 + 24 + 29 + 67 + 72 + 216 + 389 + 648 = 1458 = 972 * 3/2

==== 973 ====
973 = 7 × 139. It is a [[happy number]].

==== 974 ====
974 = 2 × 487. It is a nontotient.

974! - 1 is prime.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002982|title=A002982: Numbers n such that n! - 1 is prime.|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2022-05-10}}</ref>

==== 975 ====
975 = 3 × 5<sup>2</sup> × 13.

==== 976 ====
{{redirect-distinguish|976 (number)|976 number}}976 = 2<sup>4</sup> × 61. It is a [[decagonal number]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A001107|title=Sloane's A001107 : 10-gonal (or decagonal) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 977 ====
977 is a prime number, a balanced prime,<ref name="bp"/> a Chen prime, an Eisenstein prime with no imaginary part, a [[Stern prime]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A042978|title=Sloane's A042978 : Stern primes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and the sum of nine consecutive primes (89 + 97 + 101 + 103 + 107 + 109 + 113 + 127 + 131). It is a strictly non-palindromic number.<ref name="np">{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A016038|title=Sloane's A016038 : Strictly non-palindromic numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

==== 978 ====
978 = 2 × 3 × 163. It is a sphenic number and a nontotient.

There are 978 secondary structures of RNA molecules with 11 nucleotides.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A004148|Generalized Catalan numbers}}</ref>

==== 979 ====
979 = 11 × 89. It is the sum of the five smallest fourth powers: <math>979=\sum_{n=1}^{5}n^4</math>.

===980s===

==== 980 ====
980 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 5 × 7<sup>2</sup>. There are 980 ways to tile a hexagon of edge 3 with [https://www.cs.utexas.edu/users/EWD/transcriptions/EWD10xx/EWD1055.html calissons] of side 1.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A008793|title=A008793|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2022-05-10}}</ref>

==== 981 ====
981 = 3<sup>2</sup> × 109.

==== 982 ====

982 = 2 × 491.

==== 983 ====

983 is a prime number, a [[safe prime]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A005385|title=Sloane's A005385 : Safe primes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a Chen prime, and an Eisenstein prime with no imaginary part. It is a [[Wedderburn–Etherington number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A001190|title=Sloane's A001190 : Wedderburn-Etherington numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> and a strictly non-palindromic number.<ref name="np"/>

==== 984 ====
984 = 2<sup>3</sup> × 3 × 41.

==== 985 ====
985 = 5 × 197. It is a [[Markov number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002559|title=Sloane's A002559 : Markoff (or Markov) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a [[Pell number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000129|title=Sloane's A000129 : Pell numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> a Smith number,<ref name="is"/> and the sum of three consecutive primes (317 + 331 + 337).

==== 986 ====
986 = 2 × 17 × 29. It is a sphenic number, a [[strobogrammatic]] number, and a nontotient. There are 986 unimodal compositions of 14 where the maximal part appears once.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A006330|Number of corners, or planar partitions of n with only one row and one column}}</ref>

==== 987 ====
987 = 3 × 7 × 47. It is a [[deficient number]], a [[sphenic number]], and the 16th number of the [[Fibonacci sequence]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000045|title=Sloane's A000045 : Fibonacci numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref> There are 987 [[oeis:A000607|partitions of 52 into prime parts]].

==== 988 ====
{{Redirect|988 (number)|the suicide prevention hotline phone number|Suicide and Crisis Lifeline}}
988 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 13 × 19. It is a nontotient, a [[cake number]], and the sum of four consecutive primes (239 + 241 + 251 + 257).

==== 989 ====
989 = 23 × 43. It is an extra strong [[Lucas pseudoprime]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A217719|title=Sloane's A0217719 : Extra strong Lucas pseudoprimes|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-11}}</ref>

===990s===

==== 990 ====
990 = 2 × 3<sup>2</sup> × 5 × 11. It is a Harshad number, the 44th [[triangular number]],<ref name="tn"/> and the sum of six consecutive primes (151 + 157 + 163 + 167 + 173 + 179).

The highest possible [[VantageScore]] credit score is 990.

==== 991 ====
991 is a prime number, a Chen prime, a lucky prime, and a [[oeis:A006450|prime index prime]]. It is the sum of five consecutive primes (191 + 193 + 197 + 199 + 211) and the sum of seven consecutive primes (127 + 131 + 137 + 139 + 149 + 151 + 157).

==== 992 ====
992 = 2<sup>5</sup> × 31. It is a [[pronic number]]<ref name="ob"/> and a nontotient. There are 992 eleven-dimensional [[exotic sphere]]s.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://math.ucr.edu/home/baez/week164.html |title=week164 |publisher=Math.ucr.edu |date=2001-01-13 |access-date=2014-05-12}}</ref>

==== 993 ====
993 = 3 × 331.

==== 994 ====
994 = 2 × 7 × 71. It is a sphenic number and a nontotient. There are 994 binary words of length 13 with all distinct runs.<ref>{{cite web|title=A351016|url=https://oeis.org/A351016|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2022-05-10}}</ref>

==== 995 ====
995 = 5 × 199.

==== 996 ====
996 = 2<sup>2</sup> × 3 × 83.

==== 997 ====
997 is the largest three-digit prime number, a [[lucky prime]], and a strictly non-palindromic number.<ref name="np"/>

==== 998 ====
998 = 2 × 499. It is a nontotient. There are 998 7-node graphs with two connected components.<ref>{{cite web|title=A275165|url=https://oeis.org/A275165|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2022-05-10}}</ref>

==== 999 ====
{{Redirect|999 (number)|the emergency phone number|999 (emergency telephone number)}}
999 = 3<sup>3</sup> × 37. It is a [[Kaprekar number]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Sloane's A006886 : Kaprekar numbers|url=https://oeis.org/A006886|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-02}}</ref> and a Harshad number.

In many video games, 999 is the maximum score that can be displayed.
